queries:
WITH name_avg AS (
    SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg
    FROM name_avg
)
SELECT n.event_name,
       n.avg_amount,
       n.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_above_mean,
       n.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean
FROM name_avg n, overall o
WHERE n.avg_amount > o.mean_avg;
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amt
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
per_name AS (
    SELECT event_name, AVG(avg_amt) AS avg_amt
    FROM per_event
    GROUP BY event_name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amt) AS m
    FROM per_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_amt AS average_budget_amount,
       p.avg_amt - o.m AS difference_from_mean,
       p.avg_amt / o.m AS ratio_to_mean
FROM per_name p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.avg_amt > o.m;
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT e.event_id, e.event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg
    FROM per_event
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_amount,
       p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean,
       p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean
FROM per_event p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg;
WITH per_name AS (
    SELECT e.event_name AS event_name, AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget b
    JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_name
    HAVING AVG(b.amount) IS NOT NULL
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS mean_avg FROM per_name
)
SELECT p.event_name,
       p.avg_amount,
       p.avg_amount - o.mean_avg AS diff_from_mean,
       p.avg_amount / o.mean_avg AS ratio_to_mean
FROM per_name p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.avg_amount > o.mean_avg
